items.title: 16 Underground – “Angel (On The Run)”

items.title: Sesame Street Recruits Post Malone For Storm Special, Releases Chappell Roan Potty Parody
items.summary: Post Malone is the latest musical artist to visit Sesame Street. The rapper-turnt-country singer and comedian Michelle Buteau will appear in Storm On Sesame Street, a new special premiering this Monday, Aug. 3 on Netflix and PBS Kids, Billboard reports.

items.title: NØ MAN Announce New Album Between The Sword And The Neck: Hear “They Have Names”
items.summary: "They Have Names," the new song from the Washington, DC hardcore/screamo band NØ MAN, is extremely heavy in all sorts of way. The heaviest part of the song, spiritually if not musically, is the end. The song itself is a fast, furious rager that bandleader Maha Shami, the daughter of Palestinian refugees, delivers with overwhelming passion and conviction: "Deny our death!

items.title: NØ MAN announce new album, share “They Have Names”
items.summary: DC hardcore band NØ MAN — which features 3/4th of Majority Rule — will follow up 2024’s great Glitter and Spit with a new album, Between the Sword and the Neck, on October 30.
